title: Optimal Belief Equilibrium
title_primary: Optimal Belief Equilibrium
authors: Jeanne Hagenbach, Frédéric Koessler
official: 官方在线 2026-09-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose a conceptual framework to study motivated beliefs in strategic settings. We consider static games in which players' utilities depend directly on their beliefs about others' actions. We introduce Optimal Belief Equilibrium (OBE), in which each player jointly chooses an action and a belief that justifies that action so as to maximize his belief-based utility given opponents' play. We characterize OBE through an auxiliary game and establish existence in finite games. As a leading case, we focus on anticipatory utility, where players value both realized and anticipated material payoffs. We analyze how equilibrium behavior varies with the intensity of anticipatory motives in several broad classes of games: coordination games, public-good contribution games, centipede games, and cheap talk. We show that optimistic beliefs about others' behavior can facilitate efficient coordination, encourage free-riding, sustain trust-based relationships, and make communication persuasive despite transparent conflicts of interest.

title: European banks and private markets: Mapping the linkages

abstract: The role of non-bank financial intermediaries in the financial system has increased markedly over recent decades. This column documents how the growth of private markets, one of the fastest growing segments of the sector, has created multiple channels of interconnection between banks, firms, institutional investors, private equity, and private credit funds. Banks’ exposures extend from lending to common borrowers, to direct lending to funds, financing vehicles and linkages with asset managers. While available measures suggest that euro area banks’ exposures remain limited, data gaps and hidden leverage make it difficult for intermediaries and supervisors to assess risks across the full intermediation chain.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，非银行金融中介在金融体系中的作用显著增强。本文记录了私人市场——该领域增长最快的部分之一——的发展如何创造了银行、企业、机构投资者、私募股权及私人信贷基金之间的多重互联渠道。银行的敞口范围从向共同借款人的贷款，扩展到对基金的直接贷款、融资工具以及与资产管理人的联系。尽管现有指标显示欧元区银行的敞口仍然有限，但数据缺口和隐性杠杆使得中介机构和监管者难以评估整个中介链条中的风险。

title: Risks and Uncertainty in Monetary Policy
title_zh: 货币政策中的风险与不确定性
title_primary: 货币政策中的风险与不确定性
title_secondary: Risks and Uncertainty in Monetary Policy
authors: Tobias Adrian, Domenico Giannone, Matteo Luciani, Mike West
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Central banks monitor macroeconomic risk through two traditions: scenario analysis, regularly used since the mid-1990s, and distributional forecasting, practiced since the late 1960s. The two are complementary but separate: scenarios provide narratives without probabilities, while predictive distributions provide probabilities with limited economic interpretation. Treating baseline forecasts and scenarios as conditional predictive densities, and distributional forecasts as reference predictive distributions, places both within a common framework and clarifies their roles. The Scenario Synthesis assigns weights to scenarios consistent with the reference distribution, offering a practical and reproducible tool for risk assessment and policy deliberation under deep uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 中央银行通过两种传统方式监测宏观经济风险：自20世纪90年代中期以来定期使用的情景分析，以及自20世纪60年代末以来实践的分布预测。两者互补但相互独立：情景提供无概率的叙事，而预测分布提供概率但经济解释有限。将基线预测和情景视为条件预测密度，将分布预测视为参考预测分布，可将两者置于统一框架内并明确其作用。情景综合法赋予与参考分布一致的情景权重，为深度不确定性下的风险评估和政策审议提供了实用且可复现的工具。

title: Optimal Notional Defined Contributions
title_zh: 最优名义缴费确定型
title_primary: 最优名义缴费确定型
title_secondary: Optimal Notional Defined Contributions
authors: CARLOS E. DA COSTA, MARCELO R. SANTOS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Notional Defined Contributions (NDC) systems mimic the incentive structure of fully funded social security while preserving the pay‐as‐you‐go nature of most current systems. We study size‐preserving social reforms that replace the current U.S. system with NDCs characterized by alternative contribution rules and deficit/GDP ratios. If one retains the current mandatory age‐independent contribution rules, we find a change to an NDC to reduce welfare: the sacrifices in distributive and insurance properties are not compensated by the efficiency gains. NDCs are, however, flexible enough to allow for alternative contribution rules that increase welfare while preserving actuarial fairness. Contributions ought to be age‐dependent and concentrated later in a worker's career. The incentive structure induces an increase in capital accumulation that results, through general equilibrium effects, in welfare gains larger for low‐productivity workers, despite the increase in income inequality as captured by the Gini coefficient.
abstract_zh: 名义确定缴费制（NDC）系统在保留当前多数制度现收现付性质的同时，模仿了完全基金制社会保障的激励机制。我们研究了规模保持型社会改革，即用具有不同缴费规则和赤字/GDP比率的NDC系统替代当前美国体系。若保留当前强制性的与年龄无关的缴费规则，我们发现转向NDC会降低福利：分配和保险属性的牺牲未被效率收益所补偿。然而，NDC系统足够灵活，允许在保持精算公平性的同时采用能够提升福利的替代缴费规则。缴费应具有年龄依赖性，并集中于劳动者职业生涯的后期。这种激励结构促使资本积累增加，通过一般均衡效应，导致低生产率工人获得更大的福利收益，尽管基尼系数所反映的收入不平等有所加剧。

title: Foreign Exchange Interventions and Intermediary Constraints
title_zh: 外汇干预与中介机构约束
title_primary: 外汇干预与中介机构约束
title_secondary: Foreign Exchange Interventions and Intermediary Constraints

official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the impact of foreign exchange interventions during periods of tight credit constraints. Expanding on the Gabaix and Maggiori (2015) model, we predict that long-lived spot interventions have larger effects on exchange rates than shortlived swaps, unanticipated interventions are more impactful, and tighter credit constraints amplify effects. Using high-frequency data on Brazilian Central Bank interventions from 1999 to 2023, we find that unanticipated spot sales of USD reserves lead to significant domestic currency appreciation and reduced covered interest parity deviations. Spot interventions outperform swaps, especially when global intermediaries are constrained, and enhance market efficiency by lowering USD borrowing costs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了信贷约束紧缩时期外汇干预的影响。在扩展Gabaix和Maggiori（2015）模型的基础上，我们预测，长期即期干预对汇率的影响大于短期互换，未预期到的干预更具影响力，且更紧的信贷约束会放大这些效应。利用1999年至2023年巴西中央银行干预的高频数据，我们发现，未预期到的美元储备即期卖出导致本币显著升值，并减少了抛补利率平价偏离。即期干预优于互换，尤其是在全球中介机构受约束时，并通过降低美元借贷成本提升了市场效率。

title: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
title_zh: 消费中的可观测性与社会互动
title_primary: 消费中的可观测性与社会互动
title_secondary: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
authors: Tullio Jappelli, Luigi Pistaferri
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using a randomized survey experiment in the Italian Survey of Consumer Expectations, we study how observability and commonality shape responses to a €1,000 employer bonus. Making an idiosyncratic bonus observable to coworkers lowers the marginal propensity to consume by 3 percentage points. Conditional on observability, extending the bonus to all coworkers raises it by 6 percentage points. Under a social-interactions model, the latter effect implies a social-interaction parameter of 0.16 and a multiplier of 1.2. Thus, consumption responses depend not only on resources but also on whether income shocks are private, public, or shared within a salient peer group.
abstract_zh: 利用意大利消费者预期调查中的随机调查实验，我们研究了可观察性与共同性如何影响对1000欧元雇主奖金的反应。将一项特定奖金向同事公开，会使边际消费倾向降低3个百分点。在可观察的条件下，将奖金扩展至所有同事，则使其提高6个百分点。在社会互动模型下，后一效应意味着社会互动参数为0.16，乘数为1.2。因此，消费反应不仅取决于资源，还取决于收入冲击是私人的、公共的，还是在显著同伴群体内共享的。

authors: Sebastian Axbard, Edmund J. Malesky, Martin Mattsson, Khoa Vu, Liaoliang Zhang 等
official: 官方在线 2025-07-06 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper exploits the random assignment of court cases to justices who exhibit varying degrees of strictness to examine how convicting corrupt officials affects local government outcomes in the Philippines. I document that convictions improve the management of local public finances and reduce associated corruption. An exploration of mechanisms suggests that legal deterrence effects contribute to these findings. The results further indicate that convictions are effective at stifling corruption among bureaucrats, but not politicians. Consistent with this heterogeneity, convictions reduce electoral competition and consequently weaken accountability for incumbent politicians.
abstract_zh: 本文利用法院案件随机分配给严格程度各异的法官这一自然实验，考察了菲律宾腐败官员定罪对地方政府结果的影响。研究发现，定罪改善了地方公共财政管理，并减少了相关腐败现象。机制探索表明，法律威慑效应是这些发现的重要成因。结果进一步显示，定罪在遏制官僚腐败方面有效，但对政治家无效。与这一异质性相符，定罪降低了选举竞争，从而削弱了对现任政治家的问责机制。

title: DP13067 Wealth Taxes and Inequality
title_zh: 财富税与不平等
title_primary: 财富税与不平等
title_secondary: DP13067 Wealth Taxes and Inequality
authors: Nicola Borri, Pietro Reichlin
official: 官方在线 2018-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze the optimal combination of wealth and labor tax rates in a model where wealth-to-income ratios and wealth inequality are rising endogenously due to unbalanced technological improvement in a two-sector economy. We consider rich and poor households, financial and housing wealth, and find that a ”realistic” optimal steady state tax structure includes some taxation of labor, zero taxation of financial wealth, a housing wealth tax on rich households and a housing wealth subsidy on poor households. These findings are robust with respect to variations in the housing demand elasticity.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个两部门经济中，由于技术改进不平衡导致财富收入比和财富不平等内生性上升的模型下，财富税与劳动税税率的最优组合。我们考虑了富裕与贫困家庭、金融财富与住房财富，并发现一个“现实”的最优稳态税收结构包括对劳动征税、对金融财富零征税、对富裕家庭征收住房财富税，以及对贫困家庭提供住房财富补贴。这些发现在住房需求弹性变化下依然稳健。

title: On-Demand Assistance: Experimental Evidence from Indonesia
title_zh: 按需援助：来自印度尼西亚的实验证据
title_primary: 按需援助：来自印度尼西亚的实验证据
title_secondary: On-Demand Assistance: Experimental Evidence from Indonesia
authors: Hanna, Rema, Olken, Benjamin A., Sumarto, Sudarno, Maulana, Achmad, Alatas, Vivi 等
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Given labor informality in developing countries, addressing employment shocks is challenging. We study Indonesia’s new approach for on-demand online applications for temporary cash assistance and online job training. Through 20 lotteries over two years, 11 million beneficiaries were selected. In nationwide, representative surveys matched with administrative data, most beneficiaries report not receiving the assistance, with no detectable impacts on employment or consumption. In contrast, survey data from applicants with working phones reveal high reported take-up and higher incomes. The results suggest that while flexible, on-demand assistance has potential, design features that allow for flexibility could hinder receipt and, thus, impact.
abstract_zh: 鉴于发展中国家普遍存在的非正规就业现象，应对就业冲击颇具挑战性。我们研究了印度尼西亚针对临时现金援助和在线职业培训的新型按需在线申请模式。通过两年间20轮抽签，共筛选出1100万受益人。在匹配行政数据的全国代表性调查中，多数受益人报告未收到援助，且未发现对就业或消费产生可检测的影响。相比之下，对拥有可用电话的申请者进行的调查数据显示，其报告领取率较高且收入水平更高。研究结果表明，尽管灵活的按需援助具有潜力，但允许灵活性的设计特征可能阻碍实际领取，进而影响政策效果。

title: What Is the Probability That the Environmentally Conscious Are Willing to Pay Higher Taxes and Higher Prices to Protect the Environment? Recent Evidence for the United States
title_zh: 环保意识者愿意支付更高税收和价格以保护环境的概率是多少？——来自美国的最新证据
title_primary: 环保意识者愿意支付更高税收和价格以保护环境的概率是多少？——来自美国的最新证据
title_secondary: What Is the Probability That the Environmentally Conscious Are Willing to Pay Higher Taxes and Higher Prices to Protect the Environment? Recent Evidence for the United States
authors: Steven T. Yen, Ernest M. Zampelli
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Americans across the country are plagued with harmful effects from air and water pollution, resource depletion, land degradation, biodiversity loss and climate change. Protecting the natural environment, ecosystems and humans from these effects will demand substantive changes in production methods, delivery processes and consumption patterns. Amassing resources to effect such changes will likely require both higher taxes and prices. Currently, the literature offers little in the way of estimating or identifying the factors important in determining the public's willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices, in principle, for environmental protection. This paper is a first attempt to fill this gap. Using data from the United States 2021 General Social Survey, we estimate a bivariate ordered probit model, enabling us to calculate average marginal effects on and average predicted probabilities of the willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices to protect the environment. Without considerable and widespread changes in attitudes and beliefs, results suggest that there is little chance that a majority of Americans will support higher prices, a smaller chance of a majority supporting higher taxes and a still smaller chance that a majority will support both higher taxes and higher prices for environmental protection.
abstract_zh: 全美各地民众正遭受空气与水污染、资源枯竭、土地退化、生物多样性丧失及气候变化带来的有害影响。保护自然环境、生态系统及人类免受这些影响，需要生产方式、配送流程和消费模式发生实质性变革。为促成此类变革而筹集资源，很可能需要提高税收和价格。目前，学术界在估算或识别决定公众原则上是否愿意为环境保护同时承担更高税收与更高价格的关键因素方面，几乎未提供任何研究。本文首次尝试填补这一空白。利用美国2021年综合社会调查数据，我们估计了双变量有序概率模型，从而能够计算公众为保护环境同时承担更高税收与更高价格的意愿的平均边际效应和平均预测概率。研究结果表明，若态度与信念未发生广泛且显著的转变，大多数美国人支持更高价格的可能性微乎其微，支持更高税收的可能性更小，而同时支持为环境保护承担更高税收与更高价格的可能性则微乎其微。

title: The impact of computer-assisted learning on students’ cognitive skills: evidence from the “Three Supplies and Two Platforms” programme in China
title_zh: 计算机辅助学习对学生认知技能的影响：来自中国“三个课堂”项目的证据
title_primary: 计算机辅助学习对学生认知技能的影响：来自中国“三个课堂”项目的证据
title_secondary: The impact of computer-assisted learning on students’ cognitive skills: evidence from the “Three Supplies and Two Platforms” programme in China
authors: Wei Liu, Xiaodong Zheng, Jingru Ren, Jingxin Liu, Xiangming Fang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the Three Supplies and Two Platforms (TSTP) programme, a large-scale computer-assisted learning (CAL) initiative in China, on the cognitive skills of lower secondary students. We draw on nationally representative panel data from the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS) and implement a difference-in-differences (DID) strategy to identify causal effects. The results indicate that TSTP increases students’ cognitive test scores by 0.177 standard deviations. We provide suggestive evidence that these gains may operate through changes in teachers’ instructional tools and practices, improvements in students’ learning experiences and learning-related skills, and increased parental engagement. The effects are heterogeneous, with larger impacts observed among disadvantaged students, particularly those with lower baseline achievement and those attending rural schools. In addition, the programme reduces the rural–urban cognitive achievement gap by 0.079 standard deviations. Overall, the findings suggest that large-scale CAL interventions can enhance cognitive outcomes and contribute to reducing educational inequality in developing country contexts. KEYWORDS: Computer-assisted learning Three Supplies and Two Platforms China cognitive skills rural–urban disparities JEL CLASSIFICATION: I21 I24 I28
abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国大规模计算机辅助学习（CAL）项目——“三通两平台”（TSTP）对初中生认知技能的影响。我们利用中国教育追踪调查（CEPS）中具有全国代表性的面板数据，采用双重差分（DID）策略识别因果效应。结果表明，TSTP使学生的认知测试成绩提高了0.177个标准差。我们提供的初步证据表明，这些成效可能通过教师教学工具与实践的变革、学生学习体验及学习相关技能的提升，以及家长参与度的增加来实现。该效应存在异质性，在弱势学生群体中影响更为显著，尤其是基线成绩较低的学生和农村学校学生。此外，该项目使城乡认知成就差距缩小了0.079个标准差。总体而言，研究结果表明，大规模CAL干预能够提升认知成果，并有助于缩小发展中国家背景下的教育不平等。关键词：计算机辅助学习；三通两平台；中国；认知技能；城乡差距 JEL分类：I21 I24 I28

title: Beyond Price: Rights Trading in Strategic Factor Markets
title_zh: 超越价格：战略要素市场中的权利交易
title_primary: 超越价格：战略要素市场中的权利交易
title_secondary: Beyond Price: Rights Trading in Strategic Factor Markets
authors: Anparasan Mahalingam, Matthew J. Higgins
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Research on strategic factor markets has largely treated the terms of exchange as price. We argue that many strategic transactions instead divide value through contractual bundles in which payment terms and control rights are interdependent. In university technology licensing, we theorize Rights Trading: contingent payment, future improvement claims, and commercialization scope operate as linked components of the contractual bundle through which surplus is allocated. Using 858 hand coded university–industry licenses, we find that contracts relying more heavily on royalty and milestone provisions grant licensees stronger future improvement claims and broader commercialization scope. The results persist across controls and fixed effects and are directionally consistent with complementary instrumental-variable, event-study, and selection-bound analyses. We further show that this relationship is stronger when university technology transfer offices have greater contracting experience, suggesting that contracting capability shapes value appropriation in strategic factor markets. More broadly, the study shows that value appropriation in strategic factor markets depends not only on what organizations pay for strategic resources, but also on how contracts allocate control over their future development and commercialization.
abstract_zh: 关于战略要素市场的研究，大多将交易条件视为价格。我们认为，许多战略交易实际上通过合同束来分配价值，其中支付条款与控制权相互依存。在大学技术许可中，我们提出"权利交易"理论：或有支付、未来改进权主张和商业化范围作为合同束中相互关联的组成部分，共同决定剩余价值的分配。通过对858份手工编码的大学-企业许可合同进行分析，我们发现更依赖提成费和里程碑条款的合同，会赋予被许可方更强的未来改进权主张和更广泛的商业化范围。这一结果在控制变量和固定效应检验中依然稳健，并与工具变量、事件研究和选择边界分析的补充检验方向一致。我们进一步发现，当大学技术转移办公室拥有更丰富的合同经验时，这种关系更为显著，表明合同能力塑造了战略要素市场中的价值获取。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了战略要素市场中的价值获取不仅取决于组织为战略资源支付的价格，还取决于合同如何分配对其未来开发和商业化的控制权。

title: Forces Behind South Australia's Unusual Structural Changes Since 1840
title_zh: 1840年以来南澳大利亚州异常结构变化背后的驱动力
title_primary: 1840年以来南澳大利亚州异常结构变化背后的驱动力
title_secondary: Forces Behind South Australia's Unusual Structural Changes Since 1840
authors: Kym Anderson
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The agricultural sector's share of GDP in growing economies typically declines but, for a century from the early 1850s, Australia's did not. That trend is most evident for the former colony and now State of South Australia (SA). Moreover, that share for SA has been almost flat since 1980 as well, along with the agricultural sector's share of SA exports. This paper seeks to shed light on the forces behind the unusual evolution of these sectoral shares for SA both up to 1950 and since 1980. The extensive time series data compiled for this paper suggest various partial explanations. For 1850–1950, they include the huge arable land area per worker, clearly defined and enforced property rights in settled rural areas as the frontier of European settlement expanded, the absence of a need to do any processing of the main 19th century exports (copper, wool and wheat), a strong public agricultural research and extension system, and the absence of major mining booms after the copper finds in the 1840s and 1860s.
abstract_zh: 在经济增长过程中，农业部门占GDP的比重通常会下降，但从19世纪50年代初开始的一个世纪里，澳大利亚的这一比重并未下降。这一趋势在前殖民地、现南澳大利亚州（SA）表现得最为明显。此外，自1980年以来，南澳大利亚州农业部门占GDP的比重以及农业部门占该州出口的比重几乎保持平稳。本文旨在揭示南澳大利亚州在1950年之前及1980年之后这些部门份额异常演变的驱动因素。本文编制的大量时间序列数据提供了多种局部解释。对于1850年至1950年期间，这些因素包括：人均可耕地面积巨大；随着欧洲定居前沿的扩展，定居农村地区明确界定并有效执行的产权；19世纪主要出口产品（铜、羊毛和小麦）无需任何加工；强大的公共农业研究与推广体系；以及19世纪40年代和60年代铜矿发现后未出现重大矿业繁荣。

title: Rule of law or rule of ties? Interregional rotation of law enforcement officials and market integration in China
title_zh: 法治还是关系网？执法官员跨区域轮岗与中国市场整合
title_primary: 法治还是关系网？执法官员跨区域轮岗与中国市场整合
title_secondary: Rule of law or rule of ties? Interregional rotation of law enforcement officials and market integration in China
authors: Changhu Xue, Sihan Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how the interregional rotation of provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission (PLAC) secretaries affects interregional market integration in China. Using province-pair panel data from 2003 to 2015, we find that a PLAC secretary’s prior work experience in another province significantly enhances market integration between the current and previous jurisdictions. The effect strengthens with longer prior tenure, consistent with regional favoritism in judicial enforcement. This mechanism is corroborated by analysis of civil court verdicts, which show that firms from connected provinces are more likely to receive favorable rulings. No similar effects are observed for other provincial officials at the same level. Moreover, the regional-favoritism effect is significantly weaker when the PLAC secretary has formal legal education or prior central-government experience, and it diminishes markedly after the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China in 2012, when a sweeping anti-corruption campaign was launched.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨省级政法委员会书记的跨区域轮岗如何影响中国区域间市场整合。利用2003年至2015年的省份配对面板数据，我们发现，政法委员会书记在其他省份的先前工作经验显著促进了其当前与先前任职地区之间的市场整合。这一效应随着先前任职时间的延长而增强，与司法执行中的区域偏袒现象相符。通过对民事法庭判决的分析，这一机制得到了佐证，显示来自关联省份的企业更有可能获得有利判决。对于同级别的其他省级官员，未观察到类似效应。此外，当政法委员会书记具备正规法律教育背景或先前在中央政府的工作经验时，区域偏袒效应显著减弱；而在2012年十八大后，随着大规模反腐运动的开展，该效应也明显降低。

title: Covered Interest Parity in Emerging Markets: Measurement and Drivers
title_zh: 新兴市场中的抛补利率平价：测度与驱动因素
title_primary: 新兴市场中的抛补利率平价：测度与驱动因素
title_secondary: Covered Interest Parity in Emerging Markets: Measurement and Drivers
authors: Dao, Mai Chi, Gourinchas, Pierre-Olivier
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the behavior of Covered Interest Parity (CIP) deviations - aka the CIP basis - in Emerging Markets (EM). A major challenge in computing the CIP basis in EM's lies in measuring local currency interest rates which are free of local credit risk. To do so, we construct a â€˜purified' CIP basis for eight major EM currencies using supranational bonds issued in EM local currencies and US dollar going back twenty years. We show that this â€˜purified' CIP basis aligns well with theory-implied predictions. In the cross-section and the time-series, the basis correlates with fundamental forces driving supply and demand for dollar forwards. Shocks to global dollar funding costs, global intermediary's balance sheet capacity, and the demand for dollar safe assets interact with currency-specific dollar hedging and funding needs in moving the CIP basis in EM's.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴市场（EM）中抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离——即CIP基差——的行为。计算新兴市场CIP基差的主要挑战在于衡量无本地信用风险的本地货币利率。为此，我们利用过去二十年新兴市场本地货币和美元计价的主权超国家债券，为八种主要新兴市场货币构建了“净化版”CIP基差。研究表明，这一“净化版”CIP基差与理论隐含预测高度吻合。在横截面和时间序列维度上，该基差与驱动美元远期供需的基本力量相关。全球美元融资成本冲击、全球中介机构资产负债表容量冲击以及美元安全资产需求冲击，会与货币特定的美元对冲和融资需求相互作用，共同影响新兴市场的CIP基差变动。

title: Cognitive versus Physical Impairment and the Use and Cost of Long-Term Care in Japan
title_zh: 认知障碍与身体障碍对日本长期护理使用及成本的影响
title_primary: 认知障碍与身体障碍对日本长期护理使用及成本的影响
title_secondary: Cognitive versus Physical Impairment and the Use and Cost of Long-Term Care in Japan
authors: Rong Fu, Sizhe Liu, Toshiaki Iizuka, Haruko Noguchi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Japan has the world’s oldest population and a universal Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) system, yet how care use and costs differ between cognitive and physical impairment remains underexamined. Using the nationally representative Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions (2016 and 2019 waves; 324,466 adults aged 65 and older), we compare the utilization, intensity, and cost of long-term care across three groups: those with a dementia diagnosis (defined as regularly receiving medical treatment for dementia), those with physical (ADL) limitations but no dementia, and those with neither. A dementia diagnosis is associated with dramatically higher care use—75.3% receive some care, versus 5.3% of the unimpaired reference group. In models adjusting for demographic and socioeconomic characteristics, dementia raises the probability of receiving formal care by 55 percentage points and informal care by 52 percentage points—roughly double the effects of ADL limitations—and, conditional on use, is associated with about 113 additional hours of formal care per month (some 60% more than physical limitations alone). We estimate formal-care costs at 1.07–4.03% of GDP (depending on the valuation method) and co-residing informal-care costs at 0.79% of GDP. Per-capita formal-care costs are substantially higher for those with dementia (about 3.5 versus 2.0 million JPY annually under the self-reported approach), whereas informal-care costs are nearly uniform across impairment types—underscoring the intensive, and largely invisible, contribution of family caregivers. With the dementia and mild-cognitive-impairment population projected to reach roughly 12 million by 2040, these findings point to mounting fiscal and family-care pressures from cognitive impairment in Japan.
abstract_zh: 日本拥有全球最老龄人口及全民长期护理保险（LTCI）体系，但认知障碍与身体功能障碍在护理使用及成本方面的差异尚未得到充分研究。基于全国代表性数据《综合生活状况调查》（2016年与2019年两轮调查；涵盖324,466名65岁及以上老年人），我们比较了三类群体的长期护理使用率、强度及成本：确诊痴呆症群体（定义为定期接受痴呆症医学治疗者）、存在身体活动能力（ADL）限制但无痴呆症群体，以及无上述两类问题的群体。痴呆症诊断与显著更高的护理使用率相关——75.3%的该群体接受某种形式的护理，而参照组（无功能障碍者）仅为5.3%。在调整人口与社会经济特征的模型中，痴呆症使接受正式护理的概率提高55个百分点，接受非正式护理的概率提高52个百分点——约为ADL限制效应的两倍；且在已使用护理的条件下，每月正式护理时长增加约113小时（较单纯身体功能障碍群体高出约60%）。我们估算正式护理成本占GDP的1.07%-4.03%（取决于估值方法），同住非正式护理成本占GDP的0.79%。按人均计算，痴呆症群体的正式护理成本显著更高（自报法下年均约350万日元 vs. 200万日元），而非正式护理成本在不同功能障碍类型间近乎一致——凸显家庭照护者密集且近乎隐形的贡献。鉴于痴呆症及轻度认知障碍人口预计到2040年将达约1200万，这些发现表明日本因认知障碍面临日益加剧的财政与家庭照护压力。

title: Importing Aggregate Demand
title_zh: 进口总需求
title_primary: 进口总需求
title_secondary: Importing Aggregate Demand
authors: Chen Lian, Dmitry Mukhin, Christian K. Wolf
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How exposed are open economies to global demand shocks? In equilibrium, foreign booms can be absorbed either by domestic consumption ("quantities") or by real exchange rate appreciation ("prices"). We show that failures of Ricardian equivalence and global financial market imperfections, two frictions popular in much recent work, have opposite effects on the split: while elevated marginal propensities to consume push towards quantities, financial frictions instead increase price adjustment. As the flexible-price equilibrium generally features a mix of quantity and price responses, policy needs to be contractionary to achieve flexible-price outcomes if the spending effect dominates, and vice-versa if financial frictions are severe. In our quantitative explorations the spending effect tends to win the race, necessitating aggressive domestic policy action.
abstract_zh: 开放经济体对全球需求冲击的暴露程度如何？在均衡状态下，国外经济繁荣可通过国内消费（“数量”）或实际汇率升值（“价格”）两种渠道吸收。本文证明，李嘉图等价失效与全球金融市场不完善——近期研究中常见的两种摩擦——对上述分配机制产生相反影响：边际消费倾向上升会推动数量调整，而金融摩擦则强化价格调整。由于弹性价格均衡通常兼具数量与价格反应特征，当支出效应占主导时，政策需采取紧缩措施以实现弹性价格结果；反之，若金融摩擦严重，则需采取扩张政策。在量化分析中，支出效应往往占据上风，这要求采取积极的国内政策干预。

title: Restoration Responsibility in a Dynamic Game of Deforestation, Production, and Pollution Accumulation
title_zh: 毁林、生产与污染累积动态博弈中的恢复责任
title_primary: 毁林、生产与污染累积动态博弈中的恢复责任
title_secondary: Restoration Responsibility in a Dynamic Game of Deforestation, Production, and Pollution Accumulation
authors: F. E. Ouardighi, G. Gnecco, Eugene Khmelnitsky, M. Sanguineti
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines which country should undertake forest restoration when production and deforestation jointly degrade environmental absorption capacity. We develop a two-country dynamic game in which a forest owner derives revenues from deforestation while a non-owner benefits from production; both generate emissions, but only deforestation directly reduces carbon sink efficiency. Restoration is costly and subject to inertia. Consistent with international governance frameworks, the restoring country commits to a predetermined restoration path, while the non-restorer may either commit or retain strategic flexibility. Under homogeneous strategies, long-run environmental outcomes are independent of which country restores. Under heterogeneous strategies, however, the allocation of restoration responsibility becomes crucial: assigning restoration to the producer may aggravate environmental degradation and lead to history-dependent, potentially irreversible dynamics, whereas assigning it to the deforester mitigates opportunistic behavior and promotes more stable outcomes. A novel finding is that history-dependency is both control-specific and parameter-dependent: the deforester’s deforestation and restoration controls exhibit strong Skiba behavior robustly across parametric regimes, while the producer’s emissions exhibit weak Skiba behavior when economically dominant but become more sensitive to initial conditions when the deforester dominates. These results reflect an asymmetry in transmission channels and suggest that robust environmental protection requires aligning restoration responsibilities with forest ownership.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨当生产与毁林共同削弱环境吸收能力时，应由哪个国家承担森林恢复责任。我们构建了一个两国动态博弈模型：森林所有者通过毁林获取收益，而非所有者则从生产中获益；两者均产生排放，但只有毁林行为直接降低碳汇效率。森林恢复成本高昂且存在惯性。遵循国际治理框架，恢复国承诺执行既定恢复路径，而非恢复国可选择承诺或保留战略灵活性。在策略同质化情形下，长期环境结果与恢复责任归属无关。然而在策略异质化情形下，恢复责任的分配变得至关重要：将恢复责任分配给生产国可能加剧环境退化，并引发依赖历史路径且可能不可逆的动态过程；而将其分配给毁林国则可抑制机会主义行为，促进更稳定的结果。一项新发现表明：历史路径依赖性既具有控制特异性又具有参数依赖性——毁林国的毁林与恢复控制在不同参数区间均表现出显著的Skiba行为，而生产国的排放控制在经济主导时呈现弱Skiba行为，但在毁林国主导时对初始条件更为敏感。这些结果反映了传导渠道的非对称性，并表明稳健的环境保护需要将恢复责任与森林所有权相匹配。

title: ASEAN’s Trade and Investment in a Fragmented World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的东盟贸易与投资
title_primary: 碎片化世界中的东盟贸易与投资
title_secondary: ASEAN’s Trade and Investment in a Fragmented World
authors: Giovanni Donato & Emmanouil Kitsios
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the short- and medium-term effects of the 2018–19 China-U.S. tariff increases on the trade and investment flows of ASEAN member economies. Using granular trade data, we demonstrate that several ASEAN countries experienced a disproportionate growth in exports of products that were targeted by these tariffs. To further explore the dynamic and often immediate responses of international capital flows to these trade policy shifts, we leverage a novel firm-level FDI database that allows us to identify surges in sectoral investment inflows. Among ASEAN countries, Vietnam stands out as the one where FDI in targeted sectors grew notably faster during 2018–19, likely contributing to its observed export gains over the medium term. At the same time, our analysis reveals that trade gains in targeted products have not universally translated into stronger overall export performance across ASEAN. More generally, while trade reallocation may yield short- and medium-term gains, these gains can be offset over time by the higher long-term aggregate losses associated with trade fragmentation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2018-2019年中美关税上调对东盟成员国贸易与投资流动的短期及中期影响。基于细粒度贸易数据，我们证实部分东盟国家在受关税影响产品上的出口呈现非对称增长。为深入探究国际资本流动对此类贸易政策变动的动态即时反应，我们利用新型企业层面外商直接投资数据库，识别出特定行业投资流入的激增现象。在东盟国家中，越南在2018-2019年间受关税影响行业的外商直接投资增速尤为显著，这很可能促成了其中期出口增长。与此同时，我们的分析表明，受关税影响产品的贸易收益并未普遍转化为东盟整体出口绩效的提升。更广泛而言，尽管贸易转移可能带来短期与中期收益，但这些收益会随时间推移被贸易碎片化导致的更高长期总体损失所抵消。

title: Political Fragility: The Economic Impact of Coups d’État
title_zh: 政治脆弱性：政变的经济影响
title_primary: 政治脆弱性：政变的经济影响
title_secondary: Political Fragility: The Economic Impact of Coups d’État
authors: Luc Tucker & Idrissa Aladji Aya
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study uses an entropy balancing model to show that coups d’état can reduce GDP growth by around 2.3 percentage points in the same year. This is a larger effect than some previous estimates, and is found to be persistent over time, reducing cumulative GDP growth by around five percentage points over the following five years. This study goes deeper than previous research into the drivers of that impact, finding that economic sanctions are an an important reason for the observed lower growth in many cases and that the principal channel is via private consumption and investment.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用熵平衡模型表明，政变可使当年GDP增长率降低约2.3个百分点。这一影响幅度大于部分既有研究估计值，且呈现持续性特征——在随后五年内累计减少约五个百分点的GDP增长。相较于既有研究，本研究更深入探究该影响的驱动因素，发现经济制裁是多数案例中增长放缓的重要成因，而其主要传导渠道为私人消费与投资。

title: Measuring Financial Literacy with the Big Three: Why It Works
title_zh: 用“三大问题”衡量金融素养：为何有效
title_primary: 用“三大问题”衡量金融素养：为何有效
title_secondary: Measuring Financial Literacy with the Big Three: Why It Works
authors: Tim Kaiser, Annamaria Lusardi, Olivia S. Mitchell, Luis Oberrauch
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates why the widely-used Big Three financial literacy index provides a reliable measure of financial literacy. Using an Item Response Theory framework, we estimate item difficulty and discrimination parameters and conduct a meta analysis to assess the stability of these properties across datasets and countries. Results confirm the scale's validity and reliability, with item characteristics that remain stable across populations and settings. We find no evidence of measurement differences across demographic subgroups or countries. Compared to the longer Big Five scale, the Big Three index performs similarly in measuring financial literacy and predicting financial behaviors.
abstract_zh: 本文探究为何广泛使用的“三大金融素养指数”能可靠衡量金融素养。基于项目反应理论框架，我们估算了项目的难度与区分度参数，并通过元分析评估这些属性在不同数据集与国家间的稳定性。结果证实该量表的效度与信度，其项目特征在不同人群与情境中保持稳定。我们未发现不同人口统计子群体或国家间存在测量差异的证据。相较于更长的“五大金融素养量表”，“三大指数”在衡量金融素养及预测金融行为方面表现相当。

title: Growing Awareness to Reduce Labor Abuse: An Experimental Test of a Migrant Domestic Workers’ Rights Awareness Campaign
title_zh: 减少劳工虐待意识的提升：一项针对移民家政工人权利意识运动的实验检验
title_primary: 减少劳工虐待意识的提升：一项针对移民家政工人权利意识运动的实验检验
title_secondary: Growing Awareness to Reduce Labor Abuse: An Experimental Test of a Migrant Domestic Workers’ Rights Awareness Campaign
authors: Margaret L. Boittin, Cecilia Hyunjung Mo, Biz Herman, Sarah Rich-Zendel, Soosun You
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Migrant domestic workers (MDWs) are highly vulnerable to labor abuse. Usinga survey and randomized controlled trial conducted in Hong Kong, this studyinvestigates MDWs’ labor experiences and the potential of rights awarenesscampaigns to mitigate labor abuse. The campaigns increased public knowledgeof MDWs’ rights and reduced the social acceptability of MDWs’ mistreatment.To the extent that improving knowledge about MDWs’ rights and decreasingacceptance of mistreatment affect the behaviors of employers and others whocan support MDWs, rights awareness campaigns can help reduce labor abuse.However, the campaigns had limited impact on MDWs, who demonstrated highawareness of their rights but often experienced concerning levels of abuse andregarded mistreatment as an unavoidable aspect of their employment. These differences highlight the constrained agency of MDWs to independently improvetheir labor conditions and emphasize the value of rights awareness initiativestargeting employers of MDWs and the general public.
abstract_zh: 外籍家庭佣工（MDWs）在劳动权益方面高度脆弱。本研究基于在香港开展的问卷调查与随机对照试验，考察了外籍家庭佣工的劳动经历，以及权利意识宣传活动在减少劳动虐待方面的潜力。这些宣传活动提升了公众对外籍家庭佣工权利的认知，并降低了社会对虐待外籍家庭佣工行为的接受度。在改善外籍家庭佣工权利认知与降低虐待行为接受度能够影响雇主及其他支持者行为的前提下，权利意识宣传活动有助于减少劳动虐待。然而，此类活动对外籍家庭佣工自身的影响有限——他们虽对自身权利有较高认知，却常遭遇令人担忧的虐待程度，并将虐待视为其就业中不可避免的组成部分。这些差异凸显了外籍家庭佣工在独立改善劳动条件方面受到的能力限制，并强调了针对外籍家庭佣工雇主及普通公众开展权利意识倡议的价值。

title: Convergence of Agricultural Productivity and the Influence of Fiscal Expenditure in Sub‐Saharan Africa
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲农业生产力趋同与财政支出的影响
title_primary: 撒哈拉以南非洲农业生产力趋同与财政支出的影响
title_secondary: Convergence of Agricultural Productivity and the Influence of Fiscal Expenditure in Sub‐Saharan Africa
authors: Gezahegne Seyoum, Wei Chen, Gemedo Furo, Agerie Nega Wassihun, Amenu Leta Duguma
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-05-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Agriculture is the cornerstone of sub‐Saharan Africa's (SSA) economy, contributing substantially to national income and employing a significant proportion of the labour force. Despite its economic importance, the sector remains dominated by smallholder farmers with low productivity. In response, the African Union launched the Comprehensive African Agricultural Development Program (CAADP) in 2003 to transition African agriculture from subsistence‐based to market‐oriented production through increased public investment. This study examines the impact of fiscal agricultural expenditure on agricultural productivity in the SSA region and investigates convergence in agricultural productivity across countries. Using unbalanced panel data from 30 SSA nations (2003–2023), we employed panel corrected standard errors (PCSE) to address cross‐sectional dependence, with feasible generalised least squares (FGLS) for robustness. Beta‐ and sigma‐convergence tests further assessed disparities in productivity trends. The findings reveal that agricultural expenditure has a significant impact on productivity: A 1% increase leads to a 0.02% rise in total factor productivity, a 0.05% increase in labour productivity and a 0.2% improvement in land productivity following the implementation of CAADP. In addition, the implementation period of CAADP used as a policy dummy also has a positive influence on agricultural productivity when compared to the baseline period. Similarly, the study indicates the persistent existence of absolute and conditional beta‐convergence in three agricultural measures. Meanwhile, sigma‐convergence tests confirm a reduction in dispersion of total factor productivity, but divergent results are observed for labour and land productivities. These findings suggest that heightened public investment is needed to accelerate productivity growth and narrow performance gaps in SSA's agricultural sector.
abstract_zh: 农业是撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）经济的基石，对国民收入贡献显著，并吸纳了相当比例的劳动力。尽管具有重要经济地位，该地区仍以小农生产为主，生产力水平低下。为此，非洲联盟于2003年启动《非洲农业综合发展计划》（CAADP），旨在通过增加公共投资，推动非洲农业从自给型生产向市场导向型生产转型。本研究考察了撒哈拉以南非洲地区财政农业支出对农业生产力的影响，并探究了各国农业生产力的收敛趋势。基于30个撒哈拉以南非洲国家2003—2023年的非平衡面板数据，我们采用面板校正标准误（PCSE）处理截面相依性，并以可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS）进行稳健性检验。通过β收敛和σ收敛检验进一步评估生产力趋势的差异。研究结果表明：农业支出对生产力具有显著影响——在CAADP实施后，农业支出每增加1%，全要素生产率提升0.02%，劳动生产率提高0.05%，土地生产率改善0.2%。此外，与基准期相比，作为政策虚拟变量的CAADP实施期对农业生产率同样产生正向影响。研究同时显示，三项农业指标均持续存在绝对β收敛和条件β收敛。σ收敛检验证实全要素生产率的离散程度有所降低，但劳动生产率和土地生产率呈现分化结果。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲地区需加大公共投资力度，以加速生产率增长并缩小绩效差距。

title: Concentrated MCMC estimation
title_zh: 集中式MCMC估计
title_primary: 集中式MCMC估计
title_secondary: Concentrated MCMC estimation
authors: Xuan Xiao, Xingbai Xu, Chengwei Tang, Tuo Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-05-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies a concentrated Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) estimation method that offers significant computational advantages while delivering valid inference for parameters of interest. By reducing the dimension of parameters to be sampled, this method substantially decreases computational time and memory usage relative to both traditional and some state-of-the-art Bayesian algorithms. Its applicability extends to correctly specified or misspecified likelihood functions, as well as generalized method of moments objective functions. Monte Carlo studies demonstrate that the biases and root mean squared errors of the concentrated MCMC estimators are typically smaller than or comparable to those of conventional Bayesian estimators. Furthermore, this method exhibits reliable model selection performance. We establish the large sample properties of the concentrated MCMC estimator. An empirical application analyzing the network spillover effect of stock returns in the Chinese A-share market further illustrates the advantages of this method.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种集中马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）估计方法，该方法在提供有效推断的同时，具有显著的计算优势。通过降低待采样参数的维度，与传统及部分前沿贝叶斯算法相比，该方法大幅减少了计算时间和内存使用。其适用性涵盖正确设定或错误设定的似然函数，以及广义矩方法目标函数。蒙特卡洛研究表明，集中MCMC估计器的偏差和均方根误差通常小于或相当于传统贝叶斯估计器。此外，该方法展现出可靠的模型选择性能。我们确立了集中MCMC估计器的大样本性质。一项针对中国A股市场股票收益网络溢出效应的实证应用进一步展示了该方法的优势。

title: Scalable Demand and Markups
title_zh: 可扩展需求与加成定价
title_primary: 可扩展需求与加成定价
title_secondary: Scalable Demand and Markups
authors: Enghin Atalay, Erika Frost, Alan Sorensen, Christopher Sullivan, Wanjia Zhu
official: 官方在线 2026-04-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study changes in markups across 70 product markets from 2006 to 2018. A growing literature has documented rising markups using a production function approach. We instead estimate demand and invert firms’ first-order pricing conditions to infer markups. To make the method scalable, we propose estimating nested logit demand models using household panel data to automate the assignment of products to nests. We find an overall upward trend in markups, with considerable heterogeneity across and within product markets. These increases are primarily driven by changes in firms’ marginal costs and households’ price sensitivity instead of changes in firm ownership.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了2006年至2018年间70个产品市场的加成率变化。现有文献多采用生产函数方法记录加成率的上升趋势。我们则转而估计需求，并通过反转企业的一阶定价条件来推断加成率。为使该方法具有可扩展性，我们提出利用家庭面板数据估计嵌套Logit需求模型，以自动化产品归巢分配。研究发现，加成率总体呈上升趋势，但各产品市场间及市场内部存在显著异质性。这些增长主要由企业边际成本变化和家庭价格敏感度变化驱动，而非企业所有权变动所致。

title: Abatement subsidies for groundwater conservation
title_zh: 地下水保护的减排补贴
title_primary: 地下水保护的减排补贴
title_secondary: Abatement subsidies for groundwater conservation
authors: Mani Rouhi Rad, Jordan F. Suter, Dale T. Manning, Christopher Goemans
official: 官方在线 2025-10-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Public programs that provide financial compensation for voluntary behavior have been widely used to incentivize the conservation of common property resources such as groundwater. Numerous existing groundwater conservation programs provide financial incentives to agricultural producers to permanently retire their groundwater use rights, ceasing irrigation from the associated well. This research estimates the net social benefits of a retirement policy and compares them to net benefits realized under a policy that provides subsidies for incremental reductions in groundwater use. Policies aimed at incremental groundwater use reductions have historically been ignored due, in part, to technological limitations for monitoring water use. Technological advancements make policies based on incremental changes in behavior feasible. We develop a theoretical model to compare water use behavior and welfare under the alternative policies. Then, we use a novel integrated assessment model to empirically illustrate the dynamic economic tradeoffs of the policies for a study area in Kansas. Our analysis shows that resource rents actually decrease under the retirement program relative to a baseline with no conservation policy. Further, subsidizing incremental reductions in groundwater use can dramatically increase the net social benefits of groundwater conservation relative to the retirement policy, but the choice of the subsidy policy parameters plays a critical role in determining its impact and cost to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 为自愿行为提供经济补偿的公共项目已被广泛用于激励地下水等共有财产资源的保护。众多现有的地下水保护项目向农业生产者提供经济激励，以永久放弃其地下水使用权，停止相关水井的灌溉。本研究评估了退出政策的净社会效益，并将其与对地下水使用增量减少提供补贴的政策所实现的净效益进行比较。历史上，针对地下水使用增量减少的政策常被忽视，部分原因在于监测用水量的技术限制。技术进步使得基于行为增量变化的政策变得可行。我们构建了一个理论模型，以比较不同政策下的用水行为和社会福利。随后，我们采用一种新颖的综合评估模型，实证展示了堪萨斯州研究区域内政策的动态经济权衡。我们的分析表明，与无保护政策的基准情景相比，退出项目下的资源租金实际上有所下降。此外，与退出政策相比，补贴地下水使用的增量减少可以显著提高地下水保护的净社会效益，但补贴政策参数的选择对其影响及政策制定者的成本起着关键作用。

title: Payouts smoothing and income growth
title_zh: 收入平滑与收入增长
title_primary: 收入平滑与收入增长
title_secondary: Payouts smoothing and income growth
authors: Faruk Balli Hannah Nguyen Md Iftekhar Hasan Chowdhury Hatice Ozer Balli a School of Economics and Finance, Massey University, Auckland, New Zealandb Department of Financial and Business Systems, Lincoln University, Christchurch, New Zealandc Independent Researcher
official: 官方在线 2025-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We quantify the extent and drivers of payout smoothing by employing 34,966 US firms’ data from 1975 to 2022. We report that payout growth is almost insensitive to year-by-year net income growth, in line with preceding literature suggesting payout smoothing. Novel to the literature, we incorporate the dynamics of payout smoothing, permanent, and aggregate net income growth into the depiction. Though payout growth is mostly immune to annual income growth shocks, it is significantly affected by net income growth of 5- or 10-year periods. Firms also consider the aggregate-sectoral and/or country-level-income growth in payout decisions. Since both permanent and aggregate income growths take over the role of year-by-year income growth, we further investigate if firms’ financial positions impact the magnitude of the smoothing. Annual payout growth depends more on permanent income growth for firms with higher profits and lower leverage positions. Notably, more financially vulnerable firms with higher leverage adjust payouts more in line with aggregate economic conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1975年至2022年间34,966家美国企业的数据，量化了派息平滑的程度及其驱动因素。研究发现，派息增长对逐年净收入增长几乎不敏感，这与先前文献中关于派息平滑的结论一致。本文的创新之处在于，将派息平滑的动态特征、永久性净收入增长以及总体净收入增长纳入分析框架。尽管派息增长基本不受年度收入增长冲击的影响，但显著受5年或10年期净收入增长的影响。企业在制定派息决策时，还会考虑行业总体层面和/或国家层面的收入增长。由于永久性收入增长和总体收入增长共同取代了逐年收入增长的作用，我们进一步探究企业财务状况是否影响平滑程度。对于利润较高且杠杆率较低的企业，年度派息增长更依赖于永久性收入增长。值得注意的是，杠杆率较高、财务脆弱性更强的企业，其派息调整更贴合总体经济状况的变化。

title: The Economics of Litigation Financing
title_zh: 诉讼融资的经济学
title_primary: 诉讼融资的经济学
title_secondary: The Economics of Litigation Financing
authors: Winand Emons, Francesco Parisi, Andrey Simonov, Daniil Mikhailov, Ruben Enikolopov 等
official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Third-party litigation financing involves an external party funding a legal claim, taking on the risk of loss in exchange for a share of any potential recovery. As European regulators prepare to establish a common regulatory framework for third-party litigation financing, this article draws on existing law and economics literature to examine the unique characteristics of third-party litigation financing, vis-a-vis other forms of financial support of litigation. Our findings highlight the strengths and weaknesses of different litigation-financing mechanisms in promoting socially desirable levels of litigation, adding a political economy perspective to the ongoing debates on the issue.
abstract_zh: 第三方诉讼融资是指由外部方资助法律索赔，承担败诉风险，以换取潜在赔偿金的一部分。在欧洲监管机构准备为第三方诉讼融资建立统一监管框架之际，本文借鉴现有法律与经济学文献，探讨第三方诉讼融资相较于其他诉讼资助形式的独特特征。研究结果凸显了不同诉讼融资机制在促进社会合意诉讼水平方面的优势与不足，并为当前相关争论增添了政治经济学视角。
